title: Memory · 0.5.2
description: Lumen remembers what matters to you, the same memories as on the web, and follows your About you and custom instructions.
notes: Your saved memories, About you and custom instructions now go with every chat on your iPhone, as on the web.
When you ask Lumen to remember something, or share a lasting fact, it's saved to your memory; the chat shows Memory updated.
Settings › Memory and instructions: turn memory on or off, edit About you and custom instructions, add or swipe to delete memories.
Temporary chats never use or change memory.
